name: Bedrock AgentCore Runtime
description: Deploy the Hexagen TypeScript server to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime as an ARM64 container implementing the HTTP contract (POST /invocations, GET /ping). Generates agentcore.json, an IAM execution policy, and an optional deploy GitHub Action — no Python agent scaffolding.

questions.prompt: Build type? (Container is required for a TypeScript runtime)
Inbound auth on the runtime endpoint?
Generate a deploy GitHub Action (ARM64 build -> ECR -> create/update runtime)?

checklist: Enable model access for your Bedrock model in the Bedrock console (per account, per region) — invocations fail with AccessDeniedException until you do
Wire your agent into the runtime: implement AgentRuntimePort (run / optional runStream) and pass it to createAgentCoreServer() in src/infrastructure/agentcore/http/server.ts
Build + smoke the HTTP contract locally: docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 -f Dockerfile.agentcore -t agent . ; docker run -p 8080:8080 agent ; curl localhost:8080/ping
Provision: `agentcore deploy` (agentcore-cli) — or if you chose cdk, `cdk bootstrap` once then `cdk deploy` infra/agentcore-stack.ts
Attach iam/agentcore-runtime-role.policy.json to the runtime execution role (bedrock:InvokeModel/Converse, logs, bedrock-agentcore)
Invoke: `agentcore invoke --prompt "hello"` (or boto3/SDK InvokeAgentRuntime with the ARN), then copy AGENTCORE_RUNTIME_ARN from `agentcore status` into .env.local
If observability is installed, the handler seeds the correlation store from runtimeSessionId so app logs and AgentCore's OTEL->CloudWatch traces share one id (see session.ts)
If inbound_auth=OAuth, set AGENTCORE_OAUTH_DISCOVERY_URL / AGENTCORE_OAUTH_ALLOWED_AUDIENCE; otherwise the runtime boundary is IAM (SigV4)
